title: 美伊协议激活市场滞后板块 NewEdge策略师解读
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Cameron Dawson of New Edge Wealth Writing after a small pullback to trend, the market mood is still resoundingly risk-on despite real risks. This uptrend should be respected. Cameron
segments.zh: New Edge Wealth的Cameron Dawson认为，市场小幅回调后，情绪仍强烈偏好风险，尽管存在实际风险。这一上升趋势应被尊重。

segments.en: joins us now for more and I believe you wrote that even before the agreement was signed.
segments.zh: Cameron现在加入我们，我相信你在协议签署前就写过相关观点。

segments.en: Yeah. This seems like a different moment and the market is treating it as more real as some of the other inroads into a piece deal. What's so different this time around?
segments.zh: 是的。这次似乎不同，市场认为更真实，相比之前的一些进展。这次有什么不同？

segments.en: I think what is different is that there seems to be at least some confirmation that there is some kind of agreement moving forward with a run and that is certainly breathing life into
segments.zh: 我认为不同之处在于，至少有一些确认，某种协议正在推进，这无疑为自战争开始以来滞后的市场领域注入了活力。

segments.en: areas of the market that have lagged since the start of the war. If you look at the non-SNP 500 AI trade meaning those areas that don't have any exposure to AI they're only up about 1% since the
segments.zh: 如果你看非标普500的AI交易，即那些没有AI敞口的领域，自战争开始以来仅上涨约1%。

segments.en: beginning of the war. Compare that to AI which is up 47% since the start of the war. So we know that this market has been able to make new highs because of the AI trade with a lot of other areas of the
segments.zh: 相比之下，AI自战争开始以来上涨了47%。因此，市场能创新高是因为AI交易，而其他许多领域被抛在后面。

segments.en: market left behind. So it's those left behind areas that have the most potential of course for some kind of catch up trade some kind of bid as we see a broadening out potentially in some of
segments.zh: 因此，那些被抛在后面的领域最有潜力出现追赶交易，随着市场可能拓宽，出现某种轮动中的缓解。

segments.en: this kind of relief in the rotation. How much is this really tied to the idea that it takes heat away from the central banks to have to be sort of punitive and raise rates in the face of inflation?
segments.zh: 这在多大程度上与这样的想法相关：它减轻了央行面对通胀时不得不惩罚性加息的压力？

segments.en: I think that that is a big factor in all of this because if we looked at the upward pressure on oil prices that fed into gasoline prices, fed into diesel prices all of that created that
segments.zh: 我认为这是一个重要因素，因为油价上涨压力传导至汽油和柴油价格，所有这些都造成了通胀上行压力、利率上行压力以及对更鹰派政策的预期。

segments.en: upward pressure on inflation, upward pressure on interest rates and expectations for a more hawkish
segments.zh: 以及更鹰派预期的压力。
